summary: Independent native requirements verifier approval of native-author-20261003-3. Source inspection supports the list-first reversible presentation defaults, current normal/Inbox/on-hold/containment/flag/date meanings, all-field draft retention, filtered-out proposal re-entry, exact unknown-request recovery, and conflict-aware Undo. resolved_findings.rationale: UAC-008 and UAC-010 explicitly require full preview plus Confirm/Back keyboard/touch reachability under narrow width and zoom, modal focus containment, Escape/Back preserving unsaved proposal and meaningful return focus, and host-initiated mode updates preserving review. UAC-006 requires reachable result-check/retry after unknown save with no obsolete modal trapping focus. Then statements, observations and experience outcomes/exit observations carry consistent meaning.

F-004 steps and When now agree on refresh, display/width changes, explicit view switch with dirty parent/lifecycle/date fields, and host correction removing the action from the selected view. Its Then and counterexample require a named retained-proposal route without false current-view membership; observable and experience statements are synchronized.
